active (peaks 9-18h), 250 GB","rationale":"Serverless bills compute per second and scales down overnight and off-peak, so you pay for 8 vCore only during business-hours peaks.","tradeoffs":["Cold-start/scale-up latency on load spikes","Per-vCore rate is higher while active","Only pays off if utilisation is really low availability.","tradeoffs":["Half the CPU/RAM per instance, so load testing is needed","Less headroom for peak bursts"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c2","service":"Azure App instance for roughly 60-70% of hours when load is low.","tradeoffs":["Single instance off-hours means reduced redundancy","Scale-out lag at the start of the day if not scheduled starts"],"also_replaces":[]},{"component_id":"c5","service":"Azure Container Apps","sku":"Standard","details":"Container Apps job (scheduled, cron nightly), 1 vCPU 2 GiB, ~20 min per run, consumption
